title: ADR-0001-B: hf ship performs the real develop->trunk fast-forward
objective: ADR-0001-B (develop_mirrors_trunk=true) requires ff develop->trunk after each merge so develop==trunk. Today hf ship only println!s a note (main.rs ~475-480); should_sync_develop_trunk() is consulted but NO git ff is performed. Implement the actual fast-forward (fetch + ff-only push of develop to trunk, fail-closed, permission-gated, never force) so the branch model the policy claims is real.
acceptance_criteria: ADR-0001-B: hf ship performs the real develop->trunk fast-forward: implemented + cargo test green + checkpointed
